description:
STATE, read live at handoff (2026-11-20T00:15Z, date -u). origin/dev e19c079d (read by ref after #751), origin/main e0a559dd (v0.15.0 tag peel, unchanged), package.json 0.15.0. The 0.15.0 quest/lore pair is STILL UNPUBLISHED and main is HELD for the pair: QCLI-547 and QCLI-554 carry the hold label, QCLI-551 (In Progress) too. Tree on dev is clean, nothing unpushed.

LANDED THIS SESSION (all squash, pinned with --match-head-commit): #741 QCLI-322 (opus APPROVE at ef19a6db; QCLI-322 closed); #744 QCLI-567 wrapper signal forwarding (75dabe81); #749 QCLI-572 hardening N1-N6 (aae541fd); #750 QCLI-572 round 2: DEC-282 (a3) three-fd group rule plus F1-F4 (e448171c); #746 QCLI-570 (closed); tracker PRs #743 #745 #747 #748 #751. The wrapper (bin/quest.cjs) now: async spawn; forwards SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP; owns the child process group only when none of fds 0,1,2 is a terminal; sweeps the group on exit; re-raises the child signal on itself except SIGPIPE/SIGXFSZ/SIGUSR1 (exit 128+n); spawn() throw and error exit 1. DEC-282 (a2)/(a3) are the design record (opum-doc ODOC-634).

OPEN, in order:
1. QCLI-572 (In Progress): open on AC8 only, the F4 deterministic SIGUSR1 witness (a --require preload that wraps process.kill and records a (process.pid, SIGUSR1) call), replacing stderr text as the only evidence. QCLI-572 closes when AC8 does. The owed non-blocking findings are carried as a note on QCLI-571 (no separate code PR, leader budget ruling): fd-1/fd-2 per-clause pty witnesses, the SIGUSR1 witness and its overclaiming test comment, F3 comment worded as inferred, stale duplicate comment above hasScript.
2. QCLI-571 (To Do, labels cli/release, depends QCLI-567): the LIFELINE, DEC-282 (a2) item 2, UNBUILT. The wrapper holds the write end of a pipe passed to the native child; on EOF the child kills its own group and exits (covers SIGKILL of the wrapper and a caller group kill). Touches bin/quest.cjs and the native binary (launcher class: sonnet-or-higher, opus security review, no DeepSeek). The leader said a DEC-282 (a4) brief touching QCLI-571 is coming for the successor: wait for it. QCLI-567 stays In Progress with AC1 unchecked until QCLI-571 lands. The CHANGELOG Unreleased entry states the SIGKILL/group-SIGKILL residual until then.
3. Queue after that, each needing its own brief: QCLI-449 (prompt.submit capture behind captureRequests; plugin-manifest/hook class, sonnet tier; opum-doc must hear before it ships; four design silences were routed to opum-doc), QCLI-446 (forgery guard in hooks/register.tsx), QCLI-568 (depends QCLI-563), QCLI-563 (item-5 build). QCLI-555 stays In Progress at 3/4 ACs; its AC1 is under QCLI-558: leave untouched unless told.
Review worktrees stay in place (DEC-208): review-744-1099a77/281b1b6/75dabe8, review-746-1b07dfd, review-749-aae541f, review-750-e448171, plus the older ones.

HOW TO WORK HERE (learned, not in CLAUDE.md): (a) the opum-workflow hook refuses a git push composed with another command: run git push bare in its own call; switch/create the branch in its own call before committing. (b) The ownership guard rejects shell-variable paths (a $D/$P in a path): use literal absolute paths or write a script file to the scratchpad and run it with bash. (c) script(1) rejects bun stdin pipes (a socket): give it /dev/null or run `: | node ...` inside it. (d) glibc execvp retries ENOEXEC through /bin/sh, so a non-executable-file spawn test is not portable; use a --require preload. (e) The source-gates log prints no per-test pass/skip lines: a red source-gates needs a hypothesis, then a rerun. (f) Commit mutant PREDICTIONS on the task before running mutants; run mutants from a script file that restores the file. (g) Local bun is 1.3.14 (repo pin 1.4.2): run tsc, biome format:check and the touched test files, leave bun run check to CI. (h) Merge only with gh pr merge <n> --squash --delete-branch --match-head-commit <full sha read from gh pr view>, after source-gates (two rows on a source head), Tracker integrity and lore check are all success with none pending; then switch to dev, git merge --ff-only origin/dev, git branch -D the task branch. (i) Single-quote tracker prose; write actor flags --actor quest-cli --actor-kind delegated-agent --accountable-human jdnewhouse. (j) Stale local branches from earlier sessions exist (chore/QCLI-322-close-and-followup, chore/QCLI-520-r2-followups, chore/QCLI-569-close-handoff, feat/QCLI-322-alias-collision-input, feat/QCLI-447-decision-record, main): not mine to clean without checking each for unique commits.
